title: 分光光度法与水质测定
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/176_分光光度法与水质测定.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/176_分光光度法与水质测定/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在分光光度计旁，手拿比色皿
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a benchtop spectrophotometer, holding a small square cuvette by its frosted sides, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十四课：分光光度法与水质测定。
overlay: 分光光度法与水质测定

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一管PCR反应液直接去测
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds an unpurified reaction tube and walks quickly toward a micro volume spectrophotometer, smiling confidently.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿着没纯化的反应液就去测。

shots.scene: 读数很大，他很高兴；小研皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student cheers at a big number on a blank computer screen while the female graduate student wearing safety goggles frowns at a strange spectrum curve.
shots.narration: 读数好大！小研却皱起了眉。

shots.scene: 光穿过溶液，一部分被吸收
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light beam passing through a cuvette of solution, part of the beam absorbed and a weaker beam reaching a detector. No text.
shots.narration: 光穿过溶液，一部分被吸收。

shots.scene: 浓度越大、光程越长，吸收越多
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two cuvettes, a pale one absorbing a little light and a deeper one absorbing more, an absorbance bar rising with concentration. No text.
shots.narration: 浓度越大、光程越长，吸光度越大。

shots.scene: DNA在260纳米左右有吸收峰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four nucleotide icons with slightly different absorption curves merging into one peak near two hundred sixty nanometers. No text.
shots.narration: 四种核苷酸合起来，峰在260纳米。

shots.scene: 微量型：一两微升点在检测面上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micro volume spectrophotometer with a small sample arm and a tiny droplet on a metal pedestal, a computer showing a curve, no logos. No text.
shots.narration: 微量型不用比色皿，一两微升就能测。

shots.scene: 常规型：样品装进比色皿
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a conventional spectrophotometer with a lid open over a cuvette holder, a cuvette going in, no logos. No text.
shots.narration: 常规型把样品装进比色皿测。

shots.scene: 紫外区用石英比色皿
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a quartz cuvette checked for ultraviolet range and a plastic cuvette checked only for visible range, a wavelength scale. No text.
shots.narration: 测紫外用石英皿，塑料皿只用可见区。

shots.scene: 紫外光源不直视，不开光源室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye looking at a glowing ultraviolet lamp inside an opened lamp housing crossed out, the lid closed checked. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外灯伤眼，不开光源室直视。

shots.scene: 先培训看规程，用后登记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the female graduate student an operating procedure and a usage log beside the spectrophotometer.
shots.narration: 第一次用先培训，看规程，用后登记。

shots.scene: 空白用溶解样品的同一种溶液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sample tube and a blank tube filled with the same solvent, an equals sign between the solvent parts. No text.
shots.narration: 第一步做空白，用同一种溶剂。

shots.scene: 点上空白液，合上样品臂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny droplet of water placed on the pedestal, the sample arm lowered gently. No text.
shots.narration: 点上一点五微升空白，合上样品臂。

shots.scene: 点空白，扣除溶剂吸收
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank button pressed and the solvent absorption subtracted to a flat baseline. No text.
shots.narration: 点击空白，扣除溶剂本身的吸收。

shots.scene: 【实拍】无尘纸擦净上下检测面
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a lint-free tissue wiping the lower pedestal and the upper arm surface of a micro volume spectrophotometer.
shots.narration: 无尘纸擦净上下两个检测面。

shots.scene: 【实拍】移液器竖直点样，无气泡
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a pipette held vertically placing a small clear droplet onto the pedestal, the droplet round without bubbles.
shots.narration: 移液器竖直点样，液滴不能有气泡。

shots.scene: 【实拍】比色皿只拿毛面
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved fingers holding a cuvette by its two frosted sides and wiping the clear optical faces with lens tissue.
shots.narration: 比色皿只拿毛面，擦净透光面。

shots.scene: 【实拍】装液约四分之三，光面对光路
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a cuvette filled about three quarters with clear liquid, placed in the holder with the clear faces in the light path.
shots.narration: 装液约四分之三，透光面对准光路。

shots.scene: 样品臂轻放，液体远离电脑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sample arm lowered gently, a liquid bottle kept away from the keyboard and power outlet, a spill on the keyboard crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 样品臂轻抬轻放，液体远离电脑。

shots.scene: 260纳米处出现明显吸收峰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an absorption spectrum with a clear peak at two hundred sixty nanometers. No text.
shots.narration: 260纳米处，出现一个明显的峰。

shots.scene: 软件按吸光度换算浓度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the peak height converted by a calculator icon into a concentration value. No text.
shots.narration: 软件按260处吸光度换算浓度。

shots.scene: 这个样品约200纳克每微升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a result card showing a concentration of about two hundred units with a check mark, no readable text. No text.
shots.narration: 这个样品约200纳克每微升。

shots.scene: 还要看230和280处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the spectrum with small markers at two hundred thirty and two hundred eighty nanometers where impurities absorb. No text.
shots.narration: 只看浓度不够，还要看230和280。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two absorbance bars at two hundred sixty and two hundred eighty forming a ratio near one point eight, a check mark. No text.
Diagram: two absorbance bars at two hundred sixty and two hundred thirty forming a ratio around two, a check mark. No text.

shots.scene: 又纯又浓，测量成功
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gives a thumbs up at a clean single peak spectrum on a computer screen.
shots.narration: 又纯又浓，测量成功！

shots.scene: 未纯化反应液：230处吸收很高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a distorted spectrum with a very high signal near two hundred thirty and the main peak shifted toward two hundred eighty. No text.
shots.narration: 未纯化的反应液，230处高得吓人。

shots.scene: 两个比值都明显偏低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two ratio gauges both pointing far below their normal zones, warning icons. No text.
shots.narration: 两个纯度比值，都明显偏低。

shots.scene: 蛋白、盐、残余核苷酸都在吸收
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reaction tube containing protein, salt and free nucleotide icons, each adding absorbance at two hundred sixty. No text.
shots.narration: 蛋白、盐和剩余核苷酸都在捣乱。

shots.scene: 数大不等于产物多，先纯化再定量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a big number crossed out, a purification column icon then a measurement icon with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 数大不等于产物多，先纯化再定量。

shots.scene: 先看试剂盒标签和说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reagent kit box with hazard pictograms and an instruction leaflet, a magnifier over it. No text.
shots.narration: 用试剂盒前，先看标签和说明书。

shots.scene: 重组DNA和工程菌按生物安全管理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a DNA strand and a bacteria icon inside a shield with a biohazard warning sign, a rule book. No text.
shots.narration: 重组DNA和工程菌，按生物安全管理。

shots.scene: 吸头、擦拭纸按规定收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used pipette tips and wipes dropped into a labeled waste container, a general trash bin crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用过的吸头和擦拭纸，按规定收集。

shots.scene: 水里有能被氧化的物质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water sample with various small pollutant particles that can be oxidized. No text.
shots.narration: 水里有各种能被氧化的物质。

shots.scene: 化学法氧化，消耗的氧量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxidizer icon breaking down the pollutant particles, an oxygen gauge showing the amount consumed. No text.
shots.narration: 用化学法氧化，消耗的氧量就是COD。

shots.scene: 单位毫克每升，越高越脏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three water bottles from clear to murky with a rising bar beside each. No text.
shots.narration: 单位毫克每升，越高污染越重。

shots.scene: 污水和天然水体都能衡量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wastewater outlet pipe and a river, each with a small sampling bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 污水和河湖等天然水体，都能用它衡量。

shots.scene: 难降解的也算在内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: easy to degrade and hard to degrade pollutant icons both counted into one total bar. No text.
shots.narration: 能降解的、难降解的，都算在内。

shots.scene: BOD：细菌能分解的部分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bacteria icons eating only some of the pollutant particles, a smaller bar. No text.
shots.narration: 生化需氧量只算细菌能分解的。

shots.scene: COD范围更全
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large bar for chemical demand containing a smaller bar for biological demand. No text.
shots.narration: COD两类都算，范围更全。

shots.scene: 处理后COD降了多少
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dirty inflow water entering a treatment tank and cleaner outflow water leaving, two bars. No text.
shots.narration: 污水处理后降了多少，就是COD去除。

shots.scene: 去除率=（进水−出水）/进水×100%
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simple formula card with an inflow bar minus an outflow bar divided by the inflow bar. No text.
shots.narration: 进水减出水，除以进水，乘一百。

shots.scene: 两个数单位要一致
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two values with matching unit icons checked, mismatched units crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 进水出水，单位要一致。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inflow bar of five hundred and an outflow bar of one hundred, a pie showing eighty percent removed. No text.
shots.narration: 进水五百出水一百，去除率百分之八十。

shots.scene: 消解试剂：强氧化、浓酸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed digestion tube with oxidizer, corrosive and health hazard pictograms, no liquid colors shown in detail. No text.
shots.narration: 常用方法要用强氧化剂和浓酸。

shots.scene: 六价铬致癌，有的还含汞盐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a health hazard pictogram over a chromium icon and a toxic pictogram over a mercury icon, a caution triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 含六价铬会致癌，有的还含汞盐银盐。

shots.scene: 在通风柜里操作，戴齐防护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, safety goggles, face shield and chemical resistant gloves works at a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里操作，防护戴齐。

shots.scene: 按管控化学品领用登记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a locked chemical cabinet, a sign-out log book and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 这些试剂按管控化学品领用登记。

shots.scene: 用前检查消解管有无裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a digestion tube held up to light with a magnifier showing a hairline crack, the cracked tube crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用前查管子，有裂纹会破裂喷溅。

shots.scene: 密闭消解管放进专用消解器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: capped tubes placed in a heating block reactor inside a fume hood with the sash lowered and a clear shield in front. No text.
shots.narration: 盖紧放进消解器，柜门放低加挡板。

shots.scene: 冷却后用夹子取，不用手拿
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cooling clock icon, then tongs lifting a tube from the block, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 冷却后再用夹子取，不用手拿。

shots.scene: 溅到皮肤眼睛：立即冲洗报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eyewash station and an emergency shower icon, a phone call icon. No text.
shots.narration: 溅到皮肤眼睛，立即冲洗并报告。

shots.scene: COD废液单独收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used digestion tubes emptied into a labeled acid resistant hazardous waste container in a fume hood, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: COD废液含重金属和浓酸，单独收集。

shots.scene: 不倒水槽，交危废暂存
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sealed waste container carried to a hazardous waste storage point, a drain crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不倒进水槽，交危废暂存点。

shots.scene: 废管和沾染物也按危废
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: empty digestion tubes and contaminated wipes placed into a labeled solid hazardous waste box. No text.
shots.narration: 废管和沾染物，也按危废处理。

shots.scene: 分光：空白、擦净、拿毛面、看比值
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank icon, a wiped pedestal, a cuvette held by frosted sides and a ratio icon, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 分光：先空白，擦干净，再看纯度比值。

shots.scene: COD：去除率公式
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inflow bar and an outflow bar with a percentage pie. No text.
shots.narration: COD：进水减出水，除以进水。

shots.scene: COD试剂危险，通风柜、危废
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a digestion tube with hazard pictograms, a fume hood and a hazardous waste container, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: COD试剂危险：通风柜、防护、危废。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一瓶白色晶体
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small vial of white crystals beside a water bath and a filter funnel, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：综合实验：阿司匹林合成。
